guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low (reset), data_out_q is assigned all zeros, clearing the register.
On every positive edge of clk_i when rst_ni is high, data_out_q is updated with the value of data_out_d.

uncertain_points.claim: The register updates on every clock cycle; if downstream logic expects data_out_q to be stable when a separate valid signal is asserted, a phase mismatch may cause data corruption.
uncertain_points.cond: When rst_ni=1 and clk_i toggles, data_out_q changes continuously.
uncertain_points.risk: Data out may be sampled at a wrong time, leading to incorrect data capture or metastability.
